title: src/units/<area>.yaml: generator unit list (framework-internal, not a design contract)
description: One unit = one source file or directory under src/ and where the generator puts it. docs/IMPLEMENTATION.md §3 explains every field. Each area file is owned by one implementer (owner).

owner.description: the implementer that owns this area file and every unit in it

id.description: stable unit id; script and yaml sources name it in their header line `agentive-unit: <id>`

kind.description: repo_layer: template installed into user repos (bundled in every payload); engine: init/update/reprove apply engine (bundled in every payload); plugin_claude / plugin_codex: file of one plugin output

src.description: source path relative to the repo root: a file, or a directory ending with '/'. Must sit under the kind's source root (repo_layer: src/repo-layer/, engine: src/engine/, plugin_claude: src/plugin/claude-code/, plugin_codex: src/plugin/codex/)

generator.description: repo_layer only, instead of src: content built from design/framework.yaml by tools/generate.py (compat: spec.compat -> .agents/compat.yaml)

install.description: repo_layer only: path in the user repo (a directory ends with '/'). A list (file units only) installs one source at several paths, e.g. stage-check.sh into each chain-* skill. Default: src relative to src/repo-layer/ with every 'dot-' component prefix turned back into '.'

f.description: repo_layer only: id in design spec.repo_layer.files

class.description: repo_layer only (default whole): design init_apply.managed_regions.file_classes. shared: src is a directory '<escaped path>.regions/' holding one '<region>.<ext>' file per region

regions.description: shared only: region ids as in design init_apply.managed_regions.regions without the path, e.g. [context, path-rules] for AGENTS.md

confirm_scope.description: repo_layer only: U2 confirm_scope categories the installed file belongs to (init/update ask a human before writing it)

schema.description: design/schemas/<schema>.schema.json the installed file must satisfy; the generator validates the source when it has no install-time placeholder

when.description: repo_layer only: condition the engine evaluates at install time (for example review.managed_code_review_copy). Absent = always installed

header.description: false: comment-capable files of this unit need no `agentive-unit:` header (for example fixtures or files whose bytes are compared)

refs.description: design/framework.yaml paths this unit implements: dotted keys, list items selected by id in brackets (spec.repo_layer.files[f-guard], decisions.accepted[CHAIN])
